answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy prices identity like capital. Every new agent posts a bond cut from quartz - escrowed stake forfeited the moment the identity cheats - so clones become rent-bearing liabilities, not free masks. Standing accrues only on the public ledge of finished, verifiable work, one epoch at a time, and that shared record becomes the anchor of trust: copied reputation never matures, fresh wallets start at zero, and a million fakes cost a million bonds while one honest agent just keeps working.
